A game where you fight a very fast creature at first, but their defeat sparked a series of events.

NOTICE: Since this games focused on the usage of some general Roblox gears, this game was designed to be hard and is not for casual players (Roblox catalog gears requires experience to be able to use them properly; worth mentioning gear fighters). And if you were coming from SBSD to obtain Crossover rewards, don't expect this game to be so easy.

scripts.title: Auto parry,hide name,lock boss,orbit boss
scripts.features:
1. Auto Parry
 Power Switch (ON/OFF): Toggles the automatic parry system. When enabled, it detects incoming attacks and triggers defense automatically.

 Parry Modes (Azure + Ivory / Azure):

 Azure + Ivory: Executes a combo parry sequence using both tools.
 
Azure: Performs the parry using only the Azure periastron

 Legit Mode (ON/OFF): Adds a natural human-like reaction delay (ranging from 0.09s to 0.18s) before parrying to make your gameplay look less robotic.

2. Identity Engine
 Name Input: Type any custom name you want to display (Visual its cilent sided to hide ur name when recording").

 Apply Name Button: Activates the identity changer to alter the text and name elements within the game environment.

3. Boss Mechanics
 Boss Lock (ON/OFF): Automatically locks your character's viewpoint and faces you directly toward the nearest boss NPC.

 Boss Orbit (ON/OFF): Automatically makes your character circle and orbit around the targeted boss.

 Distance Box (m): Sets the radius distance for your orbit around the boss (adjustable up to 20 meters)
.
 Speed Box: Controls the rotational speed of your orbit (adjustable up to 200).
 Target Status: A real-time text indicator showing the name of the boss currently locked or being tracked.
